sloka: तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं सहितं हेतुसंहितम् ।निशम्य हनुमान् शेषं वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत् ।। ५.३९.३२।।।।
transliteration: tadarthopahitaṁ vākyaṁ sahitaṁ hetusaṁhitam ।niśamya hanumān śeṣaṁ vākyamuttaramabravīt ।। 5.39.32।।।।

translations.english: Having heard the meaningful, courteous and logical words of Sita, Hanuman replied:
